# Field guide citations {#sec-field-guide-citations}

Generated by `tools/field-guide/citations.py`. Do not edit by hand. Every citation token a field-guide page carries, grouped by kind. The `Verify` cell names the headless check that reproduces the source: `extract` (the extraction harness), `strings` (a search over the engine binary), `test:<path>` (a unittest module), `probe:<P###>` (a Docker probe), or `kernel:<path>` (a pure-kernel check).
